title: A+Woman%27s+Worth
exif:
{"Image ImageDescription": "Perhaps this is why they equate the beauty of a Woman to Diamonds and gold. I'm no fan of Jewelry; unfortunately my loved ones still do not understand that I’m a gadget whore. I would be happier with a US $ 10 Hoya filter for my 50MM compared to a US $100 bracelet or a ring. (Hint, hint!)

Nevertheless, the colours of this gold necklace of my cousin on the day of her Flower Ceremony was beyond belief. Looking at it now full size on the LCD screen it reminds me of the value of woman. The one entity of life that tries so hard to sustain it, that one entity all of us paternal society are trying to get rid of. 

Allah does not love her, neither does Yahweh, Neither does the endless number of pagan gods and goddesses. We disgrace her with insults like the Hijab and Puberty Ceremony kind of freak shows in the 21st century whilst molecular biologists are busy sequencing the genome of every strand of chromosome in man, making way for stem cell research that would lead to a children born immune to cancer, HIV, Ebola and countless number of deadly stuff we die of in vain, today.

The intricacy and the beauty of this gold reminds me of nothing else but the intricacy and complexity, yet sullen beauty, seductive overpowering force of unimaginable magnitude and quintessential mysterious wonder that nature has provided, the perfect creature that originally inhabited the earth, Woman.
